verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm. Official developer SDKs are outside the scope of that kind of product, so this story is a category error. The firm's mention of legal tech and a software-supported transparency-register service does not show it ships any SDK or API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
